dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you tried all these before?

dialogues.speaker: Zayah
dialogues.text: Oh, they're on my To-Eat list, that's for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Zayah
dialogues.text: That Boyan told me that Chenyu Adeptea was the best... and then he hoodwinked me into buying a large batch of goods that turned out to be absolute junk!

dialogues.speaker: Zayah
dialogues.text: Then he turned around and said that it was just that batch of tea that was faulty, and now that the water and soil in Chenyu Vale are back to normal, so too are the tea leaves.

dialogues.speaker: Zayah
dialogues.text: I don't trust it. Fool me once, shame on you — fool me twice, shame on me...

dialogues.speaker: Zayah
dialogues.text: I'm going to Liyue personally, and I'll taste it for myself.
